documented: Twilio uses Account SID plus Auth Token or API key plus API secret for HTTP Basic authentication.
Official examples read TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN and TWILIO_API_SECRET environment variables.
API key and Account SIDs are identifiers, not the corresponding confidential secrets.

documented: Typeform describes random-character personal access tokens and illustrates a tfp_ prefix followed by a 40-hex body; it does not publish an exhaustive alphabet or fixed width.
Personal tokens are confidential and authorize reading, updating and deleting form data; the hands-on guide shows Authorization: Bearer authentication.
assumptions: Direct recognition uses the pinned TruffleHog v3.97.4 v2 scanner subset: case-sensitive tfp_ plus 40-59 alphanumeric/underscore body characters. These are scanner bounds, not exhaustive issuer claims.
The original Gitleaks v8.30.1 case-insensitive 59-character body with hyphen, dot and equals remains supported only with its existing bounded provider-assignment context and delimiters.
The direct subset requires complete-token boundaries, rejecting short bodies and prefixes of overlong or punctuation-extended candidates.
Legacy unprefixed tokens, arbitrary short punctuation-bearing tokens, upstream liveness checks and literal-example allowlists are not imported.
evidence.fixture_method: Preserved original matching fixtures and diagnostic inputs; added deterministic SHA-256-derived synthetic bodies covering the illustrative width, direct values, Bearer headers, assignments, scanner upper bound and meaningful boundary/legacy-subset negatives. No live keys, provider example secrets or issuer checks.

documented: Workflow tokens begin with xwfp-.
They expire after 15 minutes or when their function step completes or errors, whichever occurs first, and cannot be refreshed.
assumptions: The 16-1000 URL-safe body is heuristic; internal token grammar is not published here.
